metadata.extractionMethod: Direct inspection of the uploaded .fig archive, embedded canvas.fig binary, embedded token JSON data, source page manifest, and embedded assets. Page names were verified directly in the decompressed FIG message.
metadata.completenessReason: The FIG binary and embedded token system were inspected directly, but a full semantic Kiwi node-tree decoder was not available in the runtime. Therefore node-level counts, full hierarchy, exact geometry, auto-layout, vector paths, and per-node styles are explicitly marked as not semantically decoded rather than guessed.
